Details 
 The Faded Hat celebrates Western heritage with a patriotic edge. This high-crown, flat-bill ranch hat combines vintage Americana design with modern comfort. Crafted from durable poly knit with a foam front, it features bold screen-printed flag artwork accented by the iconic Kimes Ranch logo. A rope detail along the bill adds a timeless touch of Western charm.
 Fit : High Crown | Flat Bill | Adjustable Snapback
 Details : 5-Panel Poly Knit, Foam Front, Screen-Printed Art, Rope Detail
